name: 孢子菇

NOT tiny 2.5-head chibi, not baby-like, no cute face, no smile. Corrupted ancient forest palette: dark/moss green, bark brown, poison purple; yellow-green or teal emissive details. Entire character and appendages visible. Real transparent background alpha=0, absolutely no paper/backdrop/ground shadow or broad ambient glow. Threatening three-quarter front view facing RIGHT, compact readable silhouette and generous 15% empty margin. Reference image is STYLE ONLY; DO NOT COPY its pumpkin, body, clothing or equipment. Follow the new creature description exactly.
